No public rate card exists for agent-coordination traces; deals are negotiated case-by-case.

evidence.establishes: The measured inventory and its blocked state: 7,946 files, 16.17 GB, exact tree SHA-256, transfer not cleared, pricing not ready.
Machine-readable inventory of the archive: file counts, byte total, model groups, tree hash.
Published prices for agentic-trace data: $5,000 pilot pack (~25,000 records, 72-hour delivery) and $12K suite entry; CC BY 4.0 or commercial license terms.

The buyer category exists on a public marketplace: verbatim agentic coding trajectory sessions (system prompts, tool schemas, reasoning traces, real exit codes) sold as a data product; pricing on request.

Disclosed deal table for licensed training data ($10M archive floor to $250M/5yr publisher deals; Reddit ~$60M/yr) plus the marketplace shape: flat licenses, per-unit, recurring annual, revenue-share.
2026 rate survey: no universal rate card; niche proprietary corpora run tens of thousands of dollars; terms (exclusivity, permitted use, duration) matter as much as headline price.
